rules.description: State of charge stays between 10% and 90% of 40 MWh at all times (90% efficiency on charge, 94% on discharge).
Charge and discharge are each between 0 and 20 MW, never both in the same interval; grid import at most 20 MW.
While the substation works last, site export (solar + discharge - charge) must not exceed the amended 12 MW cap whenever the battery discharges.
The site may import from the grid (charging beyond solar output) only in intervals starting 00:00-05:45 local time.
The week starts at 50% state of charge and must end at no less than 40%.
State of charge is at least 15% at every moment between 18:00 and 22:00 local time each day.
On Tuesday 23 March from 18:00 to 21:00, while the battery discharges, site export must not exceed the DSO's 5 MW limit.
The battery neither charges nor discharges on Wednesday 24 March from 08:00 to 20:00 (inverter maintenance).
